serialized_rich_text_body.circle_ios_fallback_text: The EMPOWER Labs cohort lives inside our EMPOWER Labs community on Circle. If this is your first time using Circle, we strongly recommend that you review our walkthroughs below to get familiar with the platform. It will help you make the most of the beta cohort. General structureIn your left sidebar, you’ll see the following spaces: In the upper right corner, you’ll find your notifications, direct messages, chat threads, and bookmarks (more on these later). Click on your profile picture to view and edit your profile, adjust your notifications, or change your password.  Mobile & Desktop appWe suggest that you download the free Circle mobile app. You’ll be able to access EMPOWER Labs easily on your mobile device or on your desktop and stay up to date on all activities inside the community. BookmarksIf you come across a post or comment that you’d like to save for later, you can bookmark it and it will show up in your list of bookmarks. To bookmark a post or comment, click or tap on the three dots on the right side of the post/comment and click “Bookmark post/comment.”SearchIf you ever have a question or are looking for a topic, simply start typing a few keywords into the search bar at the top of the screen. The search result will show you where the topic you’re looking for has been mentioned in posts, comments, or lessons. Notifications To avoid unwanted emails and notifications, we suggest that you take a minute to adjust the notifications in your preferences. Click or tap on your profile picture in the top right corner and choose “Notifications.” You can adjust which notifications you want to receive as emails, within the Circle app, and on the mobile app. Don’t forget to click “Save changes” once you’ve made your adjustments. You can also turn off all notifications by clicking the red “Turn off all notifications” button in the lower left corner. Please check this Circle FAQ for more information on how to customize your Circle notifications to your preferences.
